identity.name: Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B
identity.summary: Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B is a small Mixture of Experts model with 2.7 billion activated parameters that matches the performance of state-of-the-art 7B models such as Mistral 7B and Qwen1.5-7B.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card provides no documentation of model design, development, training data, or evaluation details beyond architecture and parameter count.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card states it is a base model and advises applying post-training before use, but does not define intended uses or downstream tasks.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not describe training or tuning dataset details, collection, or curation.

possible_risks.description: Improper usage occurs when a model is used for a purpose that it was not originally designed for.
possible_risks.justification: Card advises applying post-training such as SFT, RLHF, or continued pretraining before text generation, so using it directly for generation would be improper.

specifications.model_size: 26.7 GiB of safetensors weights (28,632,144,944 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a base language model; the documentation advises applying post-training such as SFT, RLHF, or continued pretraining before use for text generation.
